name: Tebrau City Half Marathon 2026 Powered by JomRun® (aka BMW Millennium Welt Johor Half Marathon)
short_description: A half marathon event in Johor Bahru, Malaysia on 20 September 2026, offering 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distances, with registration open now.
ai_summary: The Tebrau City Half Marathon 2026, powered by JomRun and also known as the BMW Millennium Welt Johor Half Marathon, takes place on 20 September 2026 in Johor Bahru, Malaysia. Organized by Ultron, the event starts at Toppen Shopping Centre and offers three distance options: 21.1km, 10km, and 5km. Registration is currently open for runners interested in participating.
pros: Multiple distance options (21.1km, 10km, 5km) suit different runner levels
Convenient city venue at Toppen Shopping Centre

faqs.question: When is the Tebrau City Half Marathon 2026 taking place?
faqs.answer: The Tebrau City Half Marathon 2026, powered by JomRun, is scheduled to take place on 20 September 2026. The event will be held in Johor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia, starting from Toppen Shopping Centre, giving participants a full day dedicated to the race and its various distance categories.

faqs.question: What distances can I run at this event?
faqs.answer: Participants in the Tebrau City Half Marathon 2026 can choose from three distance categories: a 21.1km half marathon, a 10km run, and a 5km run. This range of options allows both experienced runners and beginners to select a distance that matches their fitness level and goals.

faqs.question: Where is the race held?
faqs.answer: The race is held in Johor Bahru, in the state of Johor, Malaysia. The starting venue is Toppen Shopping Centre, which serves as the central hub for the event, making it an accessible location for local and visiting runners alike.

faqs.question: Is registration open for this race?
faqs.answer: Yes, registration for the Tebrau City Half Marathon 2026 is currently open. Interested runners can sign up ahead of the race date of 20 September 2026, choosing from the 21.1km, 10km, or 5km distance categories offered by organizer Ultron.
